discovery_notes: Follow-up to packet 240 (b106); reuses its keys. Sources: Disney Pins Blog snippets plus Pulse Gallery (UK ArtLand dealer) listings as a second publisher. Holds released: Zootopia 2025 (per-pin listing) and Star Wars Victory & Defeat (one pin). Pulse-to-DPB-headline links for Ember & Wade, Cars 3 & Tron, Electric Mayhem, Kiss are inferred from matching subjects. Undated titles now dated OUT of window: Bruni/Flit/Hei Hei 2021-01; Gothic Princess 2021-07; Princess & Horse 2020-12/2021; Neo Nouveau 2020-11/2021-08; Ben Harman Aladdin, Hunchback, Alice & PATF 2021-11; UP & Monsters Inc Ben Harman 2024-02; Kim Possible 2022-01; Dognapper Mickey 2024-10; Pongo & Pugs 2022-10; Moana Wayfinder & Maui 2022-11; King Triton & Ariel 2024-10; Spider-Man/Infinity Conez/Sith Soda 2024-08; Peter Pan & Mermaid Lagoon 2024-09; Vasilovich Dragon on glass 2022-03; Jessica Rabbit LE300 2022-02; Alex Hovey Robin Hood 2024-01; Fantasia Conducting Mickey 2020-08. Still undated: Tea Party Reunion jumbo, later Alice Playing Card waves, Alice & Cinderella swing, BatB Oval series 2-3 members, Star Wars Helmets series 1. New undated ArtLand leads: Atlantis & Evil Hag glass, Bambi & Thumper, Chernabog jumbo LE100, Blue Fairy jumbo LE100, A Bug's Life Ben Harman, 101 Dalmatians & Aristocats Ben Harman, Your Hand in Mine Anna & Olaf, Part of Your World, Diamond Series 1, Ariel/Jasmine/Tiana Floral, Princess & Friends Series 3. 30 searches used.
